name: directory-dattorro
author: mdroberts1243 (FV-1 implementation); Jon Dattorro (reverb design)
description: Jon Dattorro's plate-reverb topology adapted to FV-1 by mdroberts1243, using input diffusion, a recirculating tank and modulated taps. Decay can approach infinite sustain.
controls: reverb time (decay... all the way up is infinite sustain in the tank)
hf loss in the tank (damping... turn up for MORE damping)
